instruction: When I open POSTERITY.mp3, by default it would be played by Apple Music. Show me how to open it using Quicktime.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' | grep -q "POSTERITY" && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' | grep -q "QuickTime Player" && echo "True" || echo "False"
